page.body:
Editing existing listings

Estimated reading: 1 minute 784 views

It very easy to edit your listings on PropertyList.es. Admins can edit all properties, only agents with the set permissions can edit all properties. Find out how to set permissions here.

You can edit your listing in various ways but the most straight forward is:

  • Click “MY LISTINGS” 
  • Find the property you want to edit.
  • Click “EDIT”.

Make easy edits to your property listing, including details, features, media, pricing, and contact information.
